record.question: Rolling resistance of a wheel depends upon (i) Vehicle load (ii) Grade (iii) Ground conditions. Which of these statements are correct?
record.explanation: PDF page 3 item 26 matches the stem. Rolling resistance depends on vehicle load and ground conditions, while grade contributes to gradient resistance rather than rolling resistance, so only (i) and (iii) are correct.
